experiments.name: XGBoost baseline
experiments.description: Current XGBoost pipeline retrained with backtest exclusion (baseline reference)

experiments.name: Chronos-2 zero-shot
experiments.description: Pretrained Chronos-2 without fine-tuning, weather + time covariates

experiments.name: Chronos-2 fine-tuned
experiments.description: Fine-tuned 5000 steps, cosine LR, all ENTSO-E + weather covariates

experiments.name: Chronos-2 + geographic neighbors
experiments.description: Fine-tuned Chronos-2 with top-3 geographic neighbor load/price as covariates

experiments.name: Chronos-2 + extended context
experiments.description: Fine-tuned Chronos-2 with 1008h context window (6 weeks instead of 4)

experiments.name: Chronos-2 net position zero-shot
experiments.description: Pretrained Chronos-2 for net position, no fine-tuning. Weather + flows + TSO covariates.

experiments.name: Chronos-2 net position fine-tuned
experiments.description: Fine-tuned 5000 steps, cosine LR. Dedicated net position model with crossborder flow covariates.

experiments.name: Baseline ensemble (persistence + hour-of-day climatology)
experiments.description: Serve-faithful floor for the champion/challenger program (ABL-68). Nothing fitted; shares its definition with the evaluation's baseline_ensemble. Not a promotion candidate.

experiments.name: Chronos-2 V010 + affine recalibration + AR(1)
experiments.description: Per-country affine recalibration of V010 plus AR(1) error correction at the true 27-51h serve lead (ABL-68). Fitted on a serve-faithful reconstruction; countries below the fitting floor pass through uncorrected.
